messages.body: diffgate worker, one more base-file ruling. SPEC 3.1 item 3 deletes that clause (installed primitives may not name src/superclaude paths); your brief says the base inherits that line and the test must assert the variant adds no occurrence beyond the base's, which suggests keeping it. Recommended (KEEP): leave line 218 byte-for-byte as the base has it (the variant differs from the base only in name, title, Usage token, Review Loop and the new Diffgate section; the clause is irrelevant to S1 critique runs); the test asserts the variant's src/superclaude count is <= the base's 1. Alternative (DELETE): apply SPEC item 3 and the variant has 0 occurrences.
